entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Logistics_Intro_BothSazon
entries.dialogueText: The atmosphere inside the State Dining Hall of Palas Rezna crackled with noble animosity. Servants had cleared the banquet tables for logistical ledgers, railway maps, and provincial supply manifests. On one side sat House Azaro's commanders in crisp uniform; on the other sat Duchess Angelica Sazon and Manus Sazon in dark Brenas velvet.
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus_Logistics_Opener
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty! The General Staff cannot conduct an offensive while our fuel convoys are held up at civilian toll gates and local rail switches in Brenas! Speed is everything in modern mechanized war. We demand unconditional military requisition authority over all rail lines, fuel depots, and granaries across Brenas!
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica_Furious_Rebuttal
entries.dialogueText: Duchess Angelica straightened with icy noble disdain, slamming a jeweled ring against the table. "Brenas is not an occupied province for Montaklar's generals to pillage! It is the historical breadbasket of Rizia and the homeland of Queen Mother Estela!"
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica_Furious_Rebuttal_2
entries.dialogueText: "Your requisition officers are already impounding trucks, seizing livestock, and threatening our mayors. If you bleed our farms dry to feed your iron tanks, winter starvation and strikes will paralyze our towns before our forces even take Wiktrany!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus_Passionate_Proposal
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty, House Sazon does not wish to see our army fail—quite the contrary. Our merchant syndicates, coastal freighters, and provincial granaries have managed Brenas logistics for centuries. Entrust rear supply to our provincial guilds, and every battalion will be fed and fueled without martial extortion.
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita_Military_Counter
entries.dialogueText: Councilor Azaro leaned forward, her gaze razor-sharp. "With all due respect to House Sazon, guild bureaucracy moves at the pace of an ox cart. If my armored spearheads stall in the mud outside Wiktrany waiting for merchant manifests, General Valdez will bring down Wehzek heavy artillery and slaughter our men!"
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena_Ledger_Audit
entries.dialogueText: Elena Werner adjusted her spectacles and tapped her pen against her leather ledger. "For Dast's sake, look at the arithmetic rather than your family heraldry! The Azaro centralized rail plan guarantees rapid delivery of shells, but hauling everything from Montaklar by heavy train burns immense quantities of refined fuel (-1 Energy) and strains the provincial grid."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena_Ledger_Audit_2
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazon syndicate plan utilizes Brenas granaries, regional rail spurs, and coastal barges along the gulf. It conserves our fuel and stiffens provincial defense in Brenas, though compensating the merchant syndicates requires direct subsidies from our royal treasury (-1 Budget)."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_Unity_Plea
entries.dialogueText: Hugo Toras shook his head gravely. "Romus, a kingdom divided against itself will fall before Wiktor Smolak. House Toras, House Azaro, and House Sazon have preserved this realm for centuries. You must bridge this divide."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Dispute_Hub_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: The entire council fell silent, waiting for your judgment. The fate of the southern supply corridor rested in your hands.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Sazon_Route
entries.dialogueText: We cannot break the back of Brenas to win a military campaign. House Sazon will oversee rear supply and transit. Utilize your guild networks, coastal freighters, and granaries to keep our army fed and our people secure.
entries.menuText: "House Sazon will manage the supply lines. Rely on Brenas granaries, coastal convoys, and local syndicates."
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_Logistics_Route"] = "Sazon"; Variable["Zille_Logistics_House"] = "Sazon"; Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] or 0) - 1; Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] or 0) + 2; Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] or 0) - 1;

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Ack_Sazon_Manus
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty!" Manus bowed with genuine reverence. "House Sazon will mobilize our finest grain syndicates and coastal barges. The people of Brenas will know their King protects them."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Ack_Sazon_Angelica
entries.dialogueText: Duchess Angelica tilted her chin proudly. "A wise and sovereign decree, Your Majesty. Brenas will stand as a steadfast bastion at your rear, and our western coastal ports will remain open for your fleet."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Sazon_Taddeus
entries.dialogueText: Duke Taddeus scowled, tossing his gloves onto the mahogany table with visible disgust. "I only hope, Your Majesty, that when Valdez's tanks counter-attack, your merchant syndicates can fire wheat bushels instead of armor-piercing shells."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Sazon_Lucita
entries.dialogueText: Lucita remained disciplined, though her jaw was clenched tight. "The General Staff will adapt our operational timetable to the guild schedules, Your Majesty. We will hold Brenas at all costs."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Azaro_Route
entries.dialogueText: Military necessity takes absolute priority. Grant the General Staff and House Azaro full requisition authority over the southern rail network and fuel depots. We need maximum attack tempo to crush Valdez before he can entrench.
entries.menuText: "Military necessity is absolute. Grant House Azaro full requisition powers to unleash a mechanized offensive."
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_Logistics_Route"] = "Azaro"; Variable["Zille_Logistics_House"] = "Azaro"; Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Energy"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Energy"] or 0) - 1; Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] or 0) + 2; Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] or 0) - 2;

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Azaro_Lucita
entries.dialogueText: Lucita saluted crisply, her eyes shining with decisive pride. "A command worthy of a warrior king, Your Majesty! Our mechanized spearheads will receive every shell and barrel of fuel without hesitation. We will shatter Valdez's lines!"
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Azaro_Taddeus
entries.dialogueText: "Montaklar's divisions are at your service, Your Majesty!" Taddeus declared firmly. "Our armored columns will drive straight through Wiktrany!"
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Ack_Azaro_Angelica
entries.dialogueText: Duchess Angelica rose from her chair, her eyes burning with icy indignation. "The Crown may take its fuel, Your Majesty. But remember this day when our farmers curse the name of Montaklar in the winter breadlines."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Ack_Azaro_Manus
entries.dialogueText: Manus bowed his head solemnly. "We will do our best to keep civil order in Brenas, Your Majesty. May your victory be swift enough to justify the burden our people must bear."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Compromise_Route
entries.dialogueText: Neither house will dictate terms unilaterally. Minister Elena Werner will chair a joint royal logistical board. Priority rail corridors will be reserved for military munitions, while Sazon guilds will oversee food procurement and local depot distribution.
entries.menuText: "Neither house will dictate terms. Elena Werner will lead a Joint Logistical Board balancing both needs."
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_Logistics_Route"] = "Compromise"; Variable["Zille_Logistics_House"] = "Compromise"; Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] or 0) + 1; Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] or 0) + 1;

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Ack_Compromise_Elena
entries.dialogueText: Elena smiled faintly, adjusting her glasses. "A thoroughly pragmatic compromise, Your Majesty. It prevents military paralysis while guarding the Crown against corrupt provincial price-gouging. I will assume personal oversight of the board immediately."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Ack_Compromise_Hugo
entries.dialogueText: "Well reasoned, Romus. Unity between our noble houses is the bedrock upon which our dynasty stands. Glovurius axa Rizia!"
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Compromise_Lucita
entries.dialogueText: Lucita nodded with measured professional respect. "The military accepts this structure, Your Majesty. We will coordinate our convoy schedules directly with Minister Werner's office."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Logistics_Intro_ManusOnly
entries.dialogueText: The State Dining Hall of Palas Rezna was tense with quiet hostility. Logistical ledgers and railway maps covered the long oak table. Facing House Azaro's uniformed generals sat Manus Sazon alone—his mother, Duchess Angelica, still absent from the court.
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] ~= true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] == true) and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Logistics_Intro_AngelicaOnly
entries.dialogueText: The State Dining Hall of Palas Rezna crackled with aristocratic tension. Across the ledger-strewn table from House Azaro's officers sat Duchess Angelica Sazon alone, representing Brenas in the absence of her son Manus.
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] ~= true and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true)

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Logistics_Intro_LeonaOnly
entries.dialogueText: The State Dining Hall of Palas Rezna was frigid with mutual suspicion. With both Angelica and Manus Sazon absent from the court, Countess Leona Sazon of Sallabes had been summoned to represent the mercantile houses of Brenas opposite House Azaro's officers.
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] ~= true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true)

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos_Logistics_Opener
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. The General Staff cannot maintain offensive tempo while fuel convoys wait behind civilian freight and local rail switches in Brenas. We require full military requisition authority over the province's rail lines, fuel tanks, and grain depots.
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == true)

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona_Sazon_Proposal
entries.dialogueText: Countess Leona Sazon adjusted her sable stole coolly. "Brenas is not a conquered fief for Montaklar's quartermasters to strip bare, Your Majesty. Our merchant guilds and coastal shipping syndicates can supply the army cleanly through our granaries and ports without provoking bread riots in Sallabes and Mave Nortus."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] ~= true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true)

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos_Military_Counter
entries.dialogueText: General Carlos Azaro tapped his leather portfolio flatly. "Merchant committees move at the speed of paperwork, Your Majesty. If our forward brigades run dry of diesel and 105mm shells outside Wiktrany, General Valdez will dismantle them piecemeal."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true)

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Angelica_ManusGone_Bridge
entries.dialogueText: With Manus no longer in the chamber, the silence after Angelica's outburst lingered heavy over the table.
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true)

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_Unity_Plea
entries.dialogueText: Laurento Esquibel folded his hands gravely. "Your Majesty, Smolak is watching for any fissure between our noble houses. Choose the supply structure that keeps both the army and the realm intact."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Ack_Sazon_Leona
entries.dialogueText: Countess Leona inclined her head with poised gratitude. "A prudent decree, Your Majesty. Our Brenas syndicates will keep the front provisioned without bleeding the countryside dry."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] ~= true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] == true)

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Sazon_Carlos
entries.dialogueText: General Carlos Azaro exhaled slowly, snapping his ledger shut. "Very well, Your Majesty. We will adjust our convoy timetables accordingly."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true)

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Azaro_Carlos
entries.dialogueText: General Carlos Azaro gave a crisp nod. "Understood, Your Majesty. Our armored spearheads will not lack for fuel or shells."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true)

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Ack_Azaro_Leona
entries.dialogueText: Countess Leona rose stiffly. "The Crown shall have its trains, Your Majesty. I pray our towns survive the winter."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] ~= true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Angelica_Executed"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_EarlyExile"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true)

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Compromise_Carlos
entries.dialogueText: General Carlos Azaro inclined his head. "An orderly compromise, Your Majesty. Our quartermasters will coordinate directly with Minister Werner."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true)
